name: little-chrome
title: Little Chrome
description: Open a URL or a search in a small chromeless browser window, with suggestions from your browser history.
author: black

commands.name: open-little-chrome
commands.title: Open Little Chrome
commands.description: Type a URL or search, then open it in a small chromeless window.

commands.name: open-url
commands.title: Open URL in Little Chrome
commands.description: Open the given URL or search in a small window, without showing suggestions.

commands.name: manage-hidden
commands.title: Manage Hidden Suggestions
commands.description: Review and unhide the history suggestions hidden from Little Chrome.

preferences.name: browser
preferences.title: Browser
preferences.description: Chromium-family browser to open windows in and read suggestions from.

preferences.name: width
preferences.title: Window Width
preferences.description: Width of the small window in pixels. Defaults to 900.

preferences.name: height
preferences.title: Window Height
preferences.description: Height of the small window in pixels. Defaults to 700.
